title: feat(lint): the publish-time null-guard gate judges a record-triggered flow's start, edge and decision-branch conditions
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8V5LEowX6a3gKsBFnZ76rYH)_
Fixes #29026

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #29482

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:发布期空值守卫门禁(`os validate` / `os build` / 运行时发布门)现在也检查「记录触发」流程的开始条件、连线条件和 decision 分支表达式;对可空字段做大小比较或算术而前面没有 `!= null` 的,直接拒收。
- 为什么改:这类流程运行时拿到的记录包含全部声明字段(空值就是 null),`budget > 200000` 在预算为空时运行失败;#28951 的 showcase 流程就是这样上线后才在运行时失败的。
- 风险与回滚:收窄了作者能发布的流程;已有流程若有此写法会在下次发布时被拒(示例应用实测零命中)。回滚 = revert 本 PR,只动 `@objectstack/lint`。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` 的流程接线段(`checkFlowNullGuards`);`packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts` 的裸名解析与宏作用域;同文件头部账本的流程行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-expressions.flow-null-guards.test.ts`,预期 11 个用例全绿,其中第一个就是 #28951 的原写法被拒。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Covered:** on a flow whose trigger kind is `record_change` (the spec's `resolveFlowTriggerKind`) and whose start `objectName` is declared, the null-guard gate now judges the start node's `config.condition`, every edge `condition` (container regions included), and every `decision` node's `conditions[].expression`. Severity `error`, the same rule and the same `!= null` remedy text (`NULL_GUARD_HINT`) as validation rules and hook conditions.
- **Bare names:** the run flattens the record's fields to top level (`seedRunVariables`), so a bare `budget` is judged as `record.budget`, but only when (a) the flow's bound set is provable (`flowCelRootScope`: no `script` / `connector_action` / `wait` / `subflow` / `map` node and no contract-less screen, no entrance that opens it), (b) no declared variable, input, `outputVariable` / iterator / error variable, screen field or node id carries the name (`collectFlowVariableNames`), and (c) it is not `record` / `previous` / `vars` / `current_user`. Anything ambiguous gets no verdict. A guard on either spelling guards both; a name bound by a comprehension macro or `cel.bind` is that binding inside its scope.
- **Start condition dominates:** what the start condition proves non-null (`provenNonNullKeys`) is presumed at every edge and branch, because `execute()` evaluates it before any node on every run.
- **Outcome clause read off the engine:** new `NullGuardOutcome` `'run-fails'`: `evaluateCondition` throws on the CEL fault (ADR-0032 §1c, never a quiet `false`), and the record-change trigger's handler catches a flow failure so it never breaks the write. The message says the run fails and the write still lands.
- **Nullability fix (fallout):** a `count` / `sum` roll-up summary is always valued (objectql's `summaryEmptySetValue`: zero children is zero; seeded on a new parent, used as the empty-aggregate fallback, backfilled). It no longer counts as nullable, on every surface the gate covers. `min` / `max` / `avg` stay nullable.
- Ledger in `validate-null-guards.ts`: the flow row now reads covered (record-triggered only), a new row records the same slots on other flows as excluded (sparse: an `api` request body, an action's empty record, a `map` item), and the bare-identifier paragraph says what the code does. The stale "No `checkNullGuards` on node/edge conditions" block in `validate-expressions.ts` is gone.

## Why

#28951: `showcase_project_escalation` edge e2, `budget > 200000` on the optional `showcase_project.budget`, passed `os validate` and failed its run with `no such overload: dyn<null> > int`. The gate's ledger excluded flow conditions only pending the widening #4811 tracked; the totality blocker was gone since #4953. The motivating condition was **bare**, so `record.`-only wiring would not have caught it; this PR catches it (positive control below).

## Tests

- `validate-expressions.flow-null-guards.test.ts` (new, 11 cases): the #28951 bare edge refused with its `where` and `path`; `record.` spelling refused, either guarded spelling accepted, `has()` named as no guard; start condition judged and its guard presumed downstream; `decision` branch judged; an edge inside a `parallel` region judged; a flow with no record trigger and an `api` flow left alone; a declared variable named like the field leaves the bare name alone while `record.budget` is still judged; a `script` node leaves bare names alone while `record.budget` is still judged; an inert non-start `config.condition` not judged; `sum` / `count` roll-ups always valued, `max` nullable; non-nullable fields never flagged.
- `validate-null-guards.test.ts`: bare-name resolution, either-spelling guards, the `has()` note on a bare read, macro and `cel.bind` shadowing, `presumed` / `provenNonNullKeys` (including a one-armed `||` proving nothing), the `run-fails` message.
- `validate-expressions.test.ts`: the old "leaves flow conditions alone" case is re-judged in place (a record-triggered edge is now refused; an inert node condition and an untriggered flow are not). Three suites whose flows compare `crm_lead.rating` to pin other verdicts declare `rating` required, so the new gate stays out of the shape verdicts they pin. The keys-read meta-test gains `summaryOperations` on `def`, a `summaryOperations` receiver row (`function`, declared by `FieldSchema.summaryOperations`), and three plumbing receivers (`rootScope`, `declaredVariables`, `nullGuardBare`).

## Acceptance notes

- **Fixture fallout, measured with the real gate** (`validateStackExpressions` over each example's flows + objects, a throwaway tsx probe): app-showcase 32 flows, app-crm 1, app-todo 4: **0 null-guard findings** on this branch and on main. Before the summary fix the count was 1: `showcase_committee_quorum`'s start condition `total_amount >= 5000`, where `total_amount` is a `sum` roll-up. The claim named that as a fixture to fix; measured, it is a false positive (the roll-up reads `0` on a report with no lines, pinned by `examples/app-showcase/test/notify-recipient-optional-fields.test.ts`), so the judge was fixed instead and the showcase is untouched. `showcase_budget_approval` e4/e5 (`budget > 500000` / `budget <= 500000`) pass because its start condition proves `budget != null`.
- **Positive control:** the same probe with `showcase_project_escalation` e2 set back to its pre-#29018 spelling `budget > 200000` reports exactly 1 finding on this branch (`flows[26].edges[1].condition`, outcome "the flow run fails at this condition") and 0 on main.
- **Not reached, on purpose:** `previous` is bound to `null` on a create leg, so on a `record-after-write` flow `previous.x != null` itself faults there; the full guard is `previous != null && previous.x != null`. The gate still reports an unguarded `previous.x` (it faults on the update leg's null) and does not accept `previous != null` alone as a guard on `previous.x`. A `screen` field's `visibleWhen` (another predicate slot) is not judged: its fault does not take the `run-fails` outcome and its real outcome is unmeasured. At the runtime publish gate bare names are never judged (the per-write snapshot makes the bound set unprovable); `record.` / `previous.` reads are.
- **File surface beyond the claim:** `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` (the wiring and the nullability judgment live there, not in `validate-null-guards.ts`), its test file, and the new wiring test file. The claimed showcase edit was not made (see the first note).
- **Skills/docs follow-up owed:** `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` says the publish gate rejects "any validation-rule or hook predicate"; it now also rejects record-triggered flow conditions. `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` already teaches `!= null` over `has()` for flow conditions but does not say it is enforced. `skills/**` is a governed surface, so neither is edited here.

## Verification

Head and tree: every reading below is on `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, branch `claude/project-thread-q8q83k`, head `b4043790` (origin/main `f95d0dba` merged in; merge base `f95d0dba`).

<details><summary>Lint package: typecheck + full suite</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 on `b4043790`; `check:test-typecheck: OK`; Test Files 190 passed (190), Tests 7852 passed (7852). `eslint --no-inline-config` over the five changed `.ts` files: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived dispatch gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `b4043790` derives 58 gate families over the 6 changed paths (753 changed lines, under the 3000 human-merge threshold). Each ran once on `b4043790`, exit codes recorded as `CMD :: exit N`; `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciles: **58 derived, 58 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; all 58 exit 0.**

- `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: exit 0, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` on the changeset (it was red on the first run, before the marker was written).
- `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`: exit 0 after `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/lint...' --filter=@objectstack/objectql` (their first run exited 3, prerequisite not built).
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: exit 0 after fetching its positive-control commit `621a4876` into the shallow clone (first run exited 3).

Not covered by the `--ran` reconciliation and left to CI: the artifact-roster and declared wide-population families, path-scheduled CI jobs, the type-check lanes and the always-runs tail.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint passes on the changed files (the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the repo's required Chinese summary).
